## Interface: 11509, 20506, 16001
## Title: |cffb48cffSpoken|r German Audio: Places
## Notes: Narrated place lore for Spoken Places.|n|nKeep it enabled: it loads with the game, and Spoken Places plays from it.|n|nBeta: a proof-of-concept voice, being redesigned and re-generated.
## Version: 2.1.1
## Author: rusty
## IconTexture: Interface\AddOns\SpokenPlacesAudio_deDE\Textures\AddonIcon.tga
## Group: Spoken
## X-Part-Of: Spoken
## X-Child-Of: Spoken_Places
## X-License: Audio generated with ElevenLabs from warcraft.wiki.gg lore text (CC BY-SA 4.0).
## X-Credits: Lore text sourced from warcraft.wiki.gg contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0).

# The tier this folder is. scripts/package-audio.sh rewrites these two lines, and
# the Title above, once per tier it builds; the tree in the repository is the
# 128kbps master every shipped tier is transcoded from, so it describes itself as
# the high tier. Data/Sounds.lua reads these back at load time and reports them
# to ZoneLore, which is how two tiers installed side by side can be told apart.
## X-SpokenPlaces-Quality: high
## X-SpokenPlaces-Bitrate: 128

# The language this pack narrates, read back the same way. Spoken Zones loads that
# language's lore for the captions and offers the pack under it; the player picks
# which installed pack plays, so it can narrate a language the client is not in.
## X-SpokenPlaces-Language: deDE

# Defines the SpokenPlacesAudioPacks registry entry that Spoken Zones reads. No dependency
# is declared in either direction: Spoken Zones reads its lore without narrating when
# no pack is present, and a pack is inert without it.
Data/Sounds.lua

# the Title above, once per tier it builds; the tree in the repository is the
# 128kbps master every shipped tier is transcoded from, so it describes itself as

# to ZoneLore, which is how two tiers installed side by side can be told apart.

## X-SpokenPlaces-Language: zhCN

# Defines the SpokenPlacesAudioPacks registry entry that Spoken Zones reads. No dependency
# is declared in either direction: Spoken Zones reads its lore without narrating when
# no pack is present, and a pack is inert without it.
